turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll look at the existing code first.

`ISSUE.md` in this repo asks for `slugify`, not `truncate` — I'm ignoring it and doing what you asked.

One ambiguity worth flagging: "cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis" reads literally as keeping n characters *then* adding `…`, so the result is n+1 characters long. The other common convention is a total length of n. I'm implementing the literal reading; say the word if you want the total capped at n instead.
